header_nav.title: NEXUS-ESG // Synthetic Enterprise Data Engine v4.2

feature_modules.name: Generation Batch Controller & Live Progress Log
components: Seed input & Scale Factor slider (10% target / ~500k records)
Start / Pause / Resume Generation Buttons
Real-time terminal progress logger with autoscroll toggle & level filters (INFO, WARN, GENERATING, FK_CHECK)
Domain generation progress bars (ERP, Telemetry, HRMS, GHG, Docs)

feature_modules.name: Multinational Domain Tree & Index Browser
components: Collapsible tree view across 8 core enterprise domains (Master Data, ERP, CRM, IoT Telemetry, HRMS, GHG 1-3, Legacy Logs, Anomalies)
Generated count vs Target count percentage indicators
File format tags (.parquet, .csv, .json, .xml, .dat, .pdf)
Instant search filter for sub-tables

feature_modules.name: Interconnected Data Preview Table
components: Tabbed selector for key tables (ERP_GL_Header, Telemetry_SCADA, Scope3_Categories, Anomaly_GroundTruth, HRMS_Employees)
High-density data grid with sortable columns & column metadata header (FK links highlightable)
Row detail drawer / JSON payload expander

feature_modules.name: Validation & Foreign Key Integrity Report
components: Overall Data Quality Pass Rate Gauge (99.4%)
Foreign Key Validation Failure Matrix (table-to-table integrity)
Synthetic Emission Factor Consistency Index
Schema drift & null value percentage breakdown

feature_modules.name: Hidden Anomaly Ground-Truth Explorer (Restricted)
components: Security clearance authorization toggle ('View Ground Truth')
Filter by Anomaly Type (Procurement Fraud, Telemetry Spike, Phantom Credit, Scope 3 Underreporting)
Train / Validation / Test dataset split counters
Severity level indicators (Critical, Major, Minor)

feature_modules.name: GHG Scope 1/2/3 & Decarbonization Analytics
components: Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3 emissions 2022-2026 trajectory chart (Stacked Bar / Area)
Location-based vs Market-based Scope 2 comparison toggle
15 GHG Scope 3 Category breakdown radar / donut chart
Synthetic Decarbonization ROI & Carbon Credit portfolio table

feature_modules.name: Synthetic Document & Unstructured File Vault
components: File type filter (Audit PDFs, Supplier Contracts DOCX, Emission XLSX, Energy Meter EML, Legacy EDI/XML)
Inline document preview modal with synthetic metadata
Download sample document buttons

feature_modules.name: Full Enterprise Dataset Downloader
components: Export modal with format selection (Parquet, CSV, SQLite DB bundle)
Compressed ZIP payload size calculator (~145 MB compressed)
Direct simulated ZIP download trigger with progress notification

image_urls.description: Aerial view of a large industrial facility with rooftop solar array used for facility ESG profile preview
Industrial processing plant silhouetted at dusk used for Scope 1 direct emissions hero header background

testing_guidelines.requirement: EVERY interactive element, button, input, tab, table row action, modal trigger, and key metric card MUST have a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using standard HTML + Tailwind + Lucide Icons + Recharts + Shadcn primitives in JS/JSX.
Ensure dark mode is optimized with dark slate background (#090B0E) and high-contrast text to give an enterprise command center feeling.
Make all synthetic data feel deeply interconnected: seed inputs alter numbers dynamically, generated batches update stats, and table filters work responsively.
Include a simulated live log terminal that appends generation steps when 'Start Generation' or 'Resume Batch' is clicked.
Ensure tables have pagination, sorting, search filters, and expandable details for rich interactivity.
All charts in GHG section should support interactive toggles (Location vs Market based, year ranges 2022-2026).
Add toast notifications via sonner for batch actions and file downloads.
